description: Static blast-radius / risk analysis of infrastructure-as-code against a bundled CIS/OPA-style ruleset. Accepts a Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json), an AWS IAM policy JSON, or a Kubernetes manifest JSON. Flags public exposure, IAM wildcards, destroy/replace of stateful resources, privileged pods, and more. Deterministic and offline (no cloud credentials). Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK with findings.

document.description: The already-parsed JSON document to analyze.

blockSeverityAtOrAbove.description: Minimum severity that yields BLOCK (default: high).

name: check_infra_plan
